body:
I have experience in all three hallucinogenic classed drugs, having experienced 1 gram in DXM and DPH, mixing DPH and DXM, and having done a 750 ug trip on LSD. I have smoked Salvia before but never to the extent I did and don't encourage nor condone the usage of illicit substances while underage and even living in your parent's house.
The time reads 10:30 pm. I created a plan earlier in the day for this trip and took the necessary precautions to smoke and get ready because I live in my parent's house and it would be horrific to be caught, especially because I didn't have a trip sitter.
I moved my laptop off my desk and sat in my chair and got ready to spark up. I was using a makeshift water bottle bong, first I got my plain leaf of salvia and piled the bowl up so it was packed super fat, then I raised the water bottle to my mouth and started inhaling while then starting my lighter and burning the entire bowl sucking everything into my lungs and holding for about what seemed to be 30 seconds and than exhaling. After each hit, it felt like gravity got stronger and stronger like it was pushing me down similar to DPH.
At one point I said fuck it and went into my closet to get my 10x extract out of a shoe I hid it inside. I continued the same process of packing my bowl fat and not letting a single spec of extract go to waste. I sparked it up, held it for 30 seconds, and exhaled. This time the gravity changed very noticeably in a way that's hard to describe. At the time I also had my airpods in my ears listening to music.
The way Salvia changed my music was as if I had taken a lot of Benadryl, smoked a lot of Weed, and just took a tab of Acid and was peaking on all three at the same time. The lyrics of the music seemed to control the environment around me while also engulfing me in that song, the words made perfect sense as if I was united with it but at the same time, it made no sense at all. The music felt like the song would never stop playing as if it was on a perfect loop forever.
My perspective was changed to a degree that was unimaginable to a typical psychonaut. It felt like everything was zoomed out, similar to smoking Weed with a low tolerance. My walls started to appear as if it was melting and I believed at one stage that I got Alice in Wonderland Syndrome because I was unable to tell how big or small something was, it was similar to trying to grab an object close to you, but that object got further and bigger in size.
The scariest part about it all was when my vision started to repeat itself, it had taken a couple of seconds after exhaling that this started to occur. I could look to the left of me and my vision would restart back to where my vision originally was before repeating back and forth rapidly. This occurred about a couple of times but faded quickly, at this point it also felt as if I was just a mind and I no longer was attached to a body like I was let go. It was like I had latency in real life, I also got into a mindset that everything that is occurring is concurrent and everyone is one of each other, I believed that I was the only one alive and I am everyone.
My next mistake was loading up another bowl of 10x extract roughly the same as the last bowl, this time I was going to hold my breath for a bit longer and make sure to light everything. I put the lighter as close as I could to the herb and took the biggest inhale as if my lungs were about to explode, I held the Salvia in for about 35 seconds and exhaled. The point of no return.
As I sat the water bottle back onto my table, I no longer knew who I was, what I even was, where I am, or what anything was. I was in a state of confusion about how I even got to where I am but continued to hear music from my airpods that were still playing and tried to relax.
At this point, everything happened in a matter of seconds. I heard voices, already familiar with voices because of deliriants, this one, in particular, grabbed my attention as if it grabbed me by my throat and told me to listen. This voice sounded like a woman, it felt like I was being watched and that there was an ominous presence right next to me
I heard voices, already familiar with voices because of deliriants, this one, in particular, grabbed my attention as if it grabbed me by my throat and told me to listen. This voice sounded like a woman, it felt like I was being watched and that there was an ominous presence right next to me
but I couldn't see them. This voice was very sinister and wanted me to obey them, it said something similar to, Come with me, it's time. I was still confused and became very delirious, once I let go of everything my vision started to repeat and during the last repeat of my vision everything was gone.
It was like I blinked and woke up in this completely different reality that felt very familiar but at the same time, I had no clue where I was. I was on a beach in line to get ice cream from a truck, looking around me nothing made sense, "Why are we so close to the beach... and why was there a park bench there?" I remember sitting down on this bench and these two people who felt extremely familiar but I had no clue who they were started questioning me why I'm sitting down. It wasn't like I completely forgot my past, I still had some reminiscences of my life before this but still was confused about who I was.
I started to pick up some cognitive skills like knowing what an object was but was still mind fucked and felt very anxious. I tried explaining to these two people that I don't know who I am or where I even am and I just need some help, no matter what I did though I literally could not speak. These two people looked very puzzled and weirded out as if I was their best friend. This did not only make me panic even more but all my memories started to fade away and I could only be in the present and not remember the past.
I could have been in this reality for a couple of minutes to a couple of hours. It was very short-lived which I was glad of and I don't recall a lot of things that happened, it was like I was dreaming.
My vision started to fade back to normal reality and my vision started to repeat but slower each time and eventually stopped. I still heard the ominous voice talking to me and once again told me that it was time to leave. Thinking of the fact that it was time to leave I mistakenly got my tinfoil bowl and emptied any remaining extract onto a napkin but I didn't realize the extract in the bowl was still hot and caused a small little fire in my room because the ashes caused the napkin to catch on fire. I ran to the bathroom and rinsed the napkin to put out the fire and threw it away in the trash.
For about twenty minutes, after the trip started to wear off, I refused to believe that I was real or anything was real because it was hard to believe that everything that I witnessed was merely just a hallucination of my own imagination and surely can't be real, at most maybe a dream. Following this, I went into a state of belief that nothing is real which caused a derealization episode for multiple days afterward, by far in my opinion the most powerful substance in the world.
